title: OneNote: multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and supplied Microsoft notice support the Windows rollout, eligibility and default availability. The documented control routes and preview restrictions check out, and the briefing explicitly preserves the unresolved capture policy and conflicting storage documentation.

claims.claim: The baseline resource type for the Pages and Notebooks policy is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.claim: The resource's value property set to 0 disables the setting.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: TCM supports this setting only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: applyOnce fails for the resource if the target setting is configured in any group-level policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: Office Apps Administrator is a supported and recommended role for Cloud Policy administration.
claims.quote: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended) | This role can manage Office apps cloud services, including policy and settings management

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes can take up to 90 minutes where policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy changes can take up to 24 hours where no policy configurations existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: The policy's Disabled value makes Copilot Pages and Notebooks creation and integration unavailable.
claims.quote: Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.claim: Disabling creation does not delete existing pages and notebooks.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted. Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy overview says policies are applied when the Office app is restarted.
claims.quote: Policies from Cloud Policy are applied only when the Office app is restarted. The behavior is the same as with Group Policy.

claims.claim: The Pages and Notebooks Cloud Policy setting offers Enabled, Disabled and Not configured values and can be scoped to groups.
claims.quote: choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy. ... For Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks ... Enabled ... Disabled ... Not configured
